<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant peak at 134.11, followed by decreasing peaks roughly 1 Da apart with intensities ~11 % (M+1) and ~0.5 % (M+2)—the pattern matches the natural carbon isotopic distribution (13C ≈1.1 % per carbon). No other element shows a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
